svg.aria-label: Minimal rotating planet with skills orbiting it. AI: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, LLMs, Reinforcement Learning, RAG. Data Science: Data Analysis and Mining, Data Cleaning and Preprocessing, Feature Engineering, Data Visualization, Optimization Algorithms. Tools and Engineering: Python, SQL, TensorFlow and Keras, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Git and GitHub, FastAPI and Backend Development.
